title: GET /api/v1/certificates: result
description: The registry as the Certificates page lists it, within the token's clusters. A token limited to some clusters is given the certificates deployed to those clusters, and their targets and State judged over those clusters alone.

certificates.description: The certificates, as the page lists them.

id.description: Value. The certificate's identifier in the registry.

common_name.description: Value. The name the certificate is issued to.

names.description: Value. Every name the certificate covers.

issuer.description: Value. The issuing authority's name; null where the certificate cannot be read.

source.description: Code. Where the material comes from: acme (issued by the manager), import (uploaded), authority (a CA file), unknown.

lifecycle.description: Code. Whether the certificate is renewed automatically (acme) or stays as it is (static), judged against certbot's archive.

readable.description: Value. Whether the certificate's material can be read.

problem.description: Text. Why the material cannot be read; null where it can.

not_after.description: Value. When the certificate expires; null where unreadable.

days_left.description: Value. Whole days to expiry, negative once expired; null where unreadable.

expired.description: Value. True once not_after has passed.

expiry_state.description: Code. The expiry's colour: healthy, warning (inside the renewal margin) or critical (a week or less, or expired); unknown where there is no date.

state.description: Whether the nodes carry the certificate, judged over the certificate's targets.

label.description: Text. The page's word, such as Published.

detail.description: Text. The sentence under the word.

tone.description: Code. healthy, warning, critical or unknown.

needs_publish.description: Value. True where some target lacks a current copy.

name.description: Value. The cluster's or the receiver's name.

kind.description: Code. cluster: rolled out by the manager. receiver: fetches on its own schedule and reports nothing back.

published_at.description: Value. When the file was written for the target; null where it never was.

current.description: Value. Whether the target carries the current copy; null where that is not known, always so for a receiver.

count.description: Value. How many certificates the token may see in all.

truncated.description: Value. True where more certificates exist than are listed.

registry.description: Code. read: the list is the registry. unreadable: the registry could not be read (or has not been yet), so the list is what the clusters' own listings say they serve, with source unknown; an empty list then says nothing. none: the installation declares no registry, and the list is the clusters' listings.

observed_at.description: Value. When the manager last tried to read the registry, whether or not it could; null where it never did.

stale.description: Value. True where the reading behind the list is older than two polls or missing: the registry, or for unreadable and none a cluster's listing.
